factions.name: Demacia
factions.description: Justice and unity; go-wide aggro with Elite and rally synergies.

factions.name: Noxus
factions.description: Strength and conquest; aggressive attack-focused strategies and Overwhelm.

factions.name: Ionia
factions.description: Balance and spirit; combat tricks, recall and deny-the-opponent's-plan tempo.

factions.name: Piltover & Zaun
factions.description: Innovation; Move/create effects, ramp and inventive value engines.

factions.name: Freljord
factions.description: Endurance and might; Frostbite, buffs, and big stat finishers.

factions.name: Shadow Isles
factions.description: Death and decay; The Harrowing, self-mill and undying/ephemeral synergies.

factions.name: Bilgewater
factions.description: Greed and plunder; gold generation and Deep sea creatures.

factions.name: Targon
factions.description: Ascension and celestial power; day/night cycle and buff-heavy auras.

factions.name: Shurima
factions.description: Ascension of the desert empire; Landmarks and leveling up scaling champions.

factions.name: Bandle City
factions.description: Yordle whimsy; go-wide tricks, tiny units and disruptive Fleeting spells.

factions.name: Spirit Blossom
factions.description: Alternate-universe spirit realm; recursion and transformation themes, added as a permanent 12th region.

cards.name: Garen
cards.description: Levels up after dealing 10+ damage; becomes near-unkillable Might of Demacia.

cards.name: Lucian
cards.description: Gains attack triggers when allies die; levels up after 3 allies die.

cards.name: Darius
cards.description: Levels up when the enemy is below 10 health; strikes for lethal reach.

cards.name: Katarina
cards.description: Levels up after 3 allies die or kill enemies in one round.

cards.name: Zed
cards.description: Creates Shadow copies; levels up by playing 3 Ionia spells.

cards.name: Karma
cards.description: Levels up after playing 4 spells; empowers Mantra spell.

cards.name: Jinx
cards.description: Levels up after you attack twice in a round; becomes a rocket-launching threat.

cards.name: Heimerdinger
cards.description: Summons Turrets that deal damage; levels up after summoning 6 turrets.

cards.name: Anivia
cards.description: Returns to hand as an egg when it dies instead of going to the graveyard.

cards.name: Sejuani
cards.description: Levels up after you Frostbite the enemy Nexus; can Vulnerable-stun enemies.

cards.name: Hecarim
cards.description: Levels up after 3 Ephemeral or Fearsome units die on either side.

cards.name: Thresh
cards.description: Collects Soul fragments from deaths to grow The Box equipment power.

cards.name: Miss Fortune
cards.description: Levels up after 6+ enemies die; Bullet Time deals damage to the weakest enemies.

cards.name: Aphelios
cards.description: Cycles through five unique gun abilities each round he strikes.

cards.name: Leona
cards.description: Levels up during Day; can stun blockers to guarantee damage through.

cards.name: Azir
cards.description: Summons Sand Soldiers when you play a card with no play this round; levels up with 6 Landmarks/Shurima cards played.

cards.name: Nasus
cards.description: Grows +1/+1 permanently whenever a unit dies.

cards.name: Teemo
cards.description: Hides Blinding Dart traps in the enemy deck; levels up after 4 traps trigger.

cards.name: Elusive Scout
cards.description: Early aggressive Elusive unit representative of the go-wide Bandle City kit.

cards.name: The Ruination
cards.description: Give all allied and enemy non-champion units -10/-10. Signature Shadow Isles board wipe.
